securityNotes: Lua packages remain sandboxed: luajava, arbitrary Java/Android classes, process execution, unrestricted filesystem and dynamic bytecode stay disabled
Package modules and resources are path-normalized, size-bounded and available only inside the installed extension archive
Physical backup attachments are checksummed, bounded, path-normalized and exclude cookies, credentials, secrets, tokens, locks and temporary files
The diagnostic browser records URL paths, methods, resource classes and header names only; it never records header values, form/password contents, response bodies or cookie values
Diagnostic WebView navigation and subresources are HTTPS-only and constrained to the source allow-list; SSL failures and mixed content are blocked
Dictionary downloads are bounded, reject HTML masquerading as data, enforce minimum entry counts and commit only after every selected dictionary validates
Online VietPhrase accepts only HTTPS resources under an explicit host allow-list; every redirect is revalidated and remote code is never executed
API keys, cookies, AI request content and temporary playback state remain excluded from portable backups
AI usage accounting stores only daily counts, character totals, retry totals and the last bounded error code
restored scene-track URIs are disabled until the user reauthorizes device-local document access
Sonic, loudness analysis, scene decode and mixer enforce bounded PCM size, supported channels, sample rates and RIFF limits
release signing secrets are read only from environment variables and are not stored in the project
